## Names

<a id="fireball_msb_set_mask"></a>
### [`fireball_msb_set_mask`](../../../src/options_and_patterns.asm#L7) `$42C5-$42C6`

*data*

Bit 8 masks of the sprite X positions for fireball 0 and 1 (sprites 6, 7): ORA values $40, $80 for MSIGX. Indexed by fireball number (0-1).

- **Read by:** [`update_fireballs`](wizard_fireballs.md#update_fireballs) [`$41CF`](../../../src/wizard_fireballs.asm#L105)

<a id="fireball_msb_clear_mask"></a>
### [`fireball_msb_clear_mask`](../../../src/options_and_patterns.asm#L10) `$42C7-$42C8`

*data*

AND values $BF, $7F that clear bit 6/7 of MSIGX. Indexed by fireball number (0-1).

- **Read by:** [`update_fireballs`](wizard_fireballs.md#update_fireballs) [`$41D4`](../../../src/wizard_fireballs.asm#L108)

<a id="option_two_players"></a>
### [`option_two_players`](../../../src/options_and_patterns.asm#L14) `$42C9`

*variable*

Game option F3: 0 = one player, 1 = two players who take turns. The title screen toggles it; the demo sets it to 0 and puts it back from option_two_players_saved.

<a id="game_over_letters_top"></a>
### [`game_over_letters_top`](../../../src/options_and_patterns.asm#L28) `$42CD-$42DE`

*data*

'GAME OVER' in big letters, top line: 18 char codes (2x2 chars for each letter, $5C = space). game_over_text_loop writes each code OR $80 to game_screen+$33 (screen row 1, column 11).

- **Read by:** [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over) [`$18F0`](../../../src/lose_fall_game_over.asm#L127)

<a id="anim_char_patterns_low_rooms"></a>
### [`anim_char_patterns_low_rooms`](../../../src/options_and_patterns.asm#L41) `$42F1-$4308`

*data*

Pixel patterns of the animated chars $61, $62, $63 for rooms 0-9: 3 records of 8 bytes (one char each). animate_scrolling_chars copies them into the charset rotated by anim_chars_phase, so the pattern scrolls vertically. anim_chars_pattern_ptr points here.

- **Referred to by:** [`animate_scrolling_chars`](animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars) [`$2C96`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L39), [`animate_scrolling_chars`](animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars) [`$2C9A`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L41)

<a id="anim_chars_speed_step"></a>
### [`anim_chars_speed_step`](../../../src/options_and_patterns.asm#L53) `$4321`

*variable*

Step of the speed curve of the animated chars (index 7..0 into anim_step_delay: 8, 6, 4, 2, 4, 6, 8 passes per step, then a pause). animate_scrolling_chars counts it down; below 0 it restarts at 7 and reverses anim_chars_direction. draw_room and the room handlers set it to 7 to restart the curve.

- **Read by:** [`animate_scrolling_chars`](animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars) [`$2C85`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L28), [`animate_scrolling_chars`](animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars) [`$2CB0`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L53), [`animate_scrolling_chars`](animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars) [`$2CBC`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L59), [`animate_scrolling_chars`](animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars) [`$2CCC`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L67)
